selection: Ten retained vault packets from Fulcrum data/book; positive supply allocations; complete borrower captures take precedence, then earliest capture for a repeated market; market position consists of market id and borrower address. This is a purposive historical sample.

stress_assumptions.loan_unit_conversion: relative collateral factor divided by loan factor; reporting using initial loan USD marks
stress_assumptions.liquidation: terminal recovery, account-level recourse; no intervening liquidation or new borrowing
stress_assumptions.holdings: hypothetical 1m USD deposit in each vault; no user attribution
